title: Force execute automations not working
body:
I have several automations. If I want to force run them from the menu, nothing happens.

I can add logs if needed.

![Screenshot_20251025_151133_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4f2f785d-d2c7-4120-b35a-c5bafabdecdd)

comments.body: What do you expect to happen? I assume it will´just run through the triggers instead of waiting for regular events which normnally run through the triggers. If so it is not like "run loop now"

Todays case : running on profile120 (120%) after flu injection several days ago. 

This profile reduced to 30% for 90 min because of exercise.

Hit hypo and decide that profile120 became too strong.

I set the regular profile but that sets the basal back ON.

I want to force my hypo automation to trigger . I force run the automation but the hypo automation doesn't trigger (the conditions are met).
Better check the entries in the AAPS  logfile. It lists the evaluation of each sub trigger and the resulting total result as fired or not.
It works. If no automation is triggered, you may not see any message
